appDescription: Delivers errand requests sent by family members to the driver and adds a stop for each accepted errand to the Pleos navigation route.

function.name: ANSWER_ERRAND_REQUEST
function.description: Answers the family errand request that the app is currently asking the driver about. Accepting adds a stop to the Pleos navigation route. Accepting on condition sends the estimated arrival time to the family member, who confirms or cancels it.

answer.description: The driver's answer to the current errand request. Use conditional when the driver asks whether arriving later than requested is fine.

function.name: CONFIRM_ERRAND_DONE
function.description: Confirms whether the driver finished the family errand at the stop the car just left, and shares the result with the family member.

done.description: True if the errand was finished, false if it could not be done.

function.name: READ_FAMILY_ERRANDS
function.description: Reads the family errand requests that are still open for the current drive, with their status.
